Scenario: Password field masks input by default

Scenario: Confirm button disabled when all fields are empty
Reason for Automation: Simple, stable gating check

Scenario: Invalid email format rejected before submission

Expected Result: Inline error shown, API not called

Scenario: Weak/short password rejected before submission
Reason for Automation: Security-relevant validation; must stay enforced across releases
Expected Result: Inline error shown, API not called

Scenario: Password/Confirm mismatch is detected
Reason for Automation: Common user error path, worth locking in with regression coverage

Scenario: Password field masks input by default
Reason for Automation: Simple, stable, cheap to verify

Reason for Automation: Core navigation regression risk area as new tabs/features are added

Scenario: Special characters do not break the page

Scenario: Filter by channel shows only matching records
Reason for Automation: Core segmentation feature used daily by hospital staff

Scenario: Clear filters resets the list
